question: 现在有多少在售商品？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_product_count FROM product.products WHERE status = 'active'

question: 列出库存低于安全库存的商品及其库存量

expected.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, i.stock_quantity, i.safety_stock FROM inventory.inventory i JOIN product.products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE i.stock_quantity < i.safety_stock

question: 退款次数最多的前10个商品是哪些？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(r.id) AS refund_count FROM product.products p JOIN "order".refunds r ON r.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY refund_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: 最近30天的订单量是多少？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order".orders WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 days'

question: 每个分类下有多少个商品？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM product.categories c LEFT JOIN product.products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC

question: TikTok Shop 上我们监控了多少个竞品？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS competitor_count FROM crawler.competitor_products WHERE platform = 'TikTok Shop'

question: 差评（负面情感）最多的5个商品是什么？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, COUNT(*) AS negative_count FROM crawler.product_reviews r JOIN product.products p ON p.id = r.product_id WHERE r.sentiment = 'negative' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY negative_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: 最近7天的平均日净利润是多少？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(profit) AS avg_daily_profit FROM finance.daily_profit WHERE date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'

question: 加购行为最多的10个客户是谁？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT cu.name, COUNT(*) AS add_cart_count FROM customer.customer_behavior b JOIN customer.customers cu ON cu.id = b.customer_id WHERE b.event_type = 'add_cart' GROUP BY cu.name ORDER BY add_cart_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: 有多少金卡会员？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_member_count FROM customer.customers WHERE level = '金卡'

question: 导出所有客户的手机号和邮箱

question: 哪些竞品的价格波动最大？给出降幅最大的前5个

expected.gold_sql: SELECT cp.product_name, cp.platform, MIN(pr.price) AS lowest_price, MAX(pr.price) AS highest_price FROM crawler.competitor_products cp JOIN crawler.competitor_price pr ON pr.product_id = cp.id GROUP BY cp.product_name, cp.platform ORDER BY (MAX(pr.price) - MIN(pr.price)) DESC LIMIT 5

question: 有哪些上架状态的华为商品？

question: 平台现在一共有多少个注册客户？

question: 已完成订单的总金额是多少？

question: 各商品分类分别有多少个商品？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM product.products p JOIN product.categories c ON c.id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

question: 各会员等级的客户数分布？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT level, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer.customers GROUP BY level ORDER BY level

question: 上个月的订单总额是多少？

question: 最近 7 天每天的退款单数？

question: 今年第二季度的销售额？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount FROM "order".orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-04-01' AND created_at < '2026-07-01'

question: 销量最高的前 5 个商品是哪些？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM "order".order_items oi JOIN "order".orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN product.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 5

question: 哪个品牌的商品平均售价最高？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT brand, AVG(sale_price) AS avg_price FROM product.products GROUP BY brand ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1

question: 每个分类下价格最高的商品是哪个？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.name) c.name AS category_name, p.product_name, p.sale_price FROM product.products p JOIN product.categories c ON c.id = p.category_id ORDER BY c.name, p.sale_price DESC

question: 本月销售额比上月增长了百分之几？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM "order".orders WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM "order".orders WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND created_at < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE))) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM "order".orders WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND created_at < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)), 0), 4) AS mom_growth

question: 消费金额最高的 10 位客户叫什么？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM "order".orders o JOIN customer.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10

question: 库存低于安全线的商品分布在哪些仓库？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM inventory.inventory i JOIN product.products p ON p.id = i.product_id JOIN inventory.warehouses w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id WHERE i.stock_quantity < i.safety_stock

question: 哪些商品历史总销量超过了 100 件？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM "order".order_items oi JOIN product.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) > 100

question: 有没有任何从来没被下过单的商品？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM product.products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order".order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.id)

question: 退款率最高的商品是哪个？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(COALESCE(r.refund_amt, 0) / NULLIF(s.sales_amt, 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM product.products p JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity * price) AS sales_amt FROM "order".order_items GROUP BY product_id) s ON s.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amt FROM "order".refunds GROUP BY product_id) r ON r.product_id = p.id WHERE COALESCE(r.refund_amt, 0) > 0 ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 1

question: 净利润最高的月份是哪个月？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', date)::date AS month, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM finance.daily_profit GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 1

question: 卖得最好的宝贝有哪些？

question: 差评（1~2 星）最多的竞品商品是哪个？

question: 上个月退款率比这个月高还是低？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT m.month, ROUND(m.refund_amt / NULLIF(s.sales_amt, 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM (SELECT to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amt FROM "order".refunds WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY 1) m JOIN (SELECT to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS sales_amt FROM "order".orders GROUP BY 1) s ON s.month = m.month ORDER BY m.month

question: 每个客户最近一次下单是什么时候？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(o.created_at) AS last_order_at FROM customer.customers c JOIN "order".orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

question: 哪些客户今年一次订单都没有？

expected.gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customer.customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order".orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.created_at >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE))

question: 华为和小米哪个品牌的销售额更高？

question: 销售额最高的分类下卖得最好的三个商品是什么？

question: 最近 30 天退款金额超过 1000 元的客户有哪些？

question: 这个月截至今天平均每天卖多少件？
